name: selection-highlight-chrome
opens_with: <esc> closes the connect dialog; drag from the band up into the banner
notes: P4-5 pane-scoping pin: the v1 live-audit measured a chrome-spanning drag painting 442 chars / 17 lines including the left rail and info widgets. iter-672's content-space points + the Drag arm's band clamp were the fix; this golden proves it — the drag runs from mid-band up to the far-right banner row, and the selection paint must stay inside the chat band (the style baseline carries the blend on transcript rows only; banner rows 2-4 keep their own rgb:3C3C50 notice styling).
